name: Theme Songs
description:
Downloads theme songs for your TV series and saves them as theme.mp3 in each series folder, where Jellyfin's built-in "Play Theme Songs" feature looks for them.

Runs nightly as a scheduled task, and optionally the moment a series is added. For each series it skips anything that already has a theme, looks up the TVDB ID, downloads at about one request per second, validates the result is a real MP3 rather than the error page a missing theme returns, writes it atomically, and refreshes the item so Jellyfin notices. Series with no theme are retried on a configurable interval instead of nightly.

Requires Jellyfin 10.11+ and write access to your TV library folders. Themes come from tvthemes.plexapp.com — free, TV only, no SLA, with gaps for very recent shows.

Never overwrites an existing theme.mp3, never writes an unvalidated file, never touches movies or music, and never deletes anything.
overview: Automatically downloads TV theme songs so Jellyfin can play them on series pages.
